bk22.was_use_when: Operational or valuation benchmarking on one metric
bk22.use_when: One current operating or valuation metric per peer (a single value each) shown as ranked columns with a median line
bk22.dont_use_when: Change in a multiple across peers, in % or x turns (use bk21); the same multiple for 2+ years or bases side by side (use bk32); many metrics at once (use bk32/bk33)
bk22.why: bk22 over-picked for peer multiple data (3 misses)

bk21.was_use_when: Precedents where the multiple is the point
bk21.use_when: A table of deals or peers where one multiple, or its change over time (% or x turns), is the point: names in rows, the value drawn as an inline bar per row, median row at the bottom
bk21.dont_use_when: Deals or peers with no multiple shown, e.g. EV and premium only (use table); more than 12 rows (use table)
bk21.why: bk22 over-picked for changes in multiples (2 misses)

bk32.was_use_when: Comparing peers on 4-6 metrics at once
bk32.was_dont_use_when: One metric (use bk22); more than 8 peers
bk32.use_when: Comparing peers on 2-6 metrics at once, or on one multiple across several years / bases (e.g. two forecast years, NTM vs LTM), as a row of bar columns per metric
bk32.why: bk22 over-picked for the same multiple on several years/bases (1 miss, part of the bk22 pattern)

fin_chart.was_use_when: One metric's trend with CAGR, actual / estimate split and a % margin strip
fin_chart.dont_use_when: Several unrelated metrics (use fin_table); two forecast cases compared (use bk11); 2-4 metrics or segments each needing its own chart (use bk36)
fin_chart.why: fin_chart over-picked for multi-case / multi-metric blocks (2 misses)

bk36.was_use_when: Historical / projected financial summary, market data
bk36.use_when: Historical / projected summary as 2-4 small charts, one per metric or segment (e.g. revenue, EBITDA, segment EBITDA with CAGRs), or market data in 2-4 panels

bk11.use_when: Two forecast cases (base vs alternative, plan vs street) compared visually: small charts per metric with both cases side by side, e.g. per-share earnings and book value under each case

table.was_use_when: Comparison tables, sources & uses, comps, precedent transactions, deal terms, requirements with detail
table.was_dont_use_when: A trend or one number per item (use a chart)
table.use_when: Labelled numbers that need exact reading: comps, precedents, sources & uses, deal terms, one-way sensitivities (down / base / up), KPI lists with change vs prior period, requirements with detail
table.dont_use_when: A trend over time (use a chart); ranking many players on one metric (use bar); 3-6 headline numbers with no extra columns (use stat_strip)
table.why: table under-picked for short labelled numeric sets (3 misses)

bar.was_use_when: Ranking players by one metric (target navy, the rest grey)
bar.dont_use_when: A time series (use column); 2-3 scenario values such as a one-way sensitivity down / base / up (use table)
bar.why: table under-picked for one-way sensitivities (2 misses)
